Sid Lee is a multidisciplinary creative collective striving to make a difference and celebrating culture with bold ideas. jobs.description: Overview The role is for Internal Audit Manager, Europe position within StoneX's EMEA Internal Audit team, based in Dublin, Ireland reporting directly to the Director of Internal Audit (EMEAA) in London. The successful candidate will lead risk-based audits across StoneX's European financial regulated businesses, providing assurance over governance, risk management and internal controls while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and SOX obligations. The role covers multiple jurisdictions and requires significant interaction with senior stakeholders. Responsibilities Responsibilities Lead and manage financial, operational, compliance/AML and internal control audits in support of the EMEA Internal Audit plan and compliance with the Sarbanes-Oxley (SOx) requirements. Plan, coordinate and deliver complex audit assignments across multiple European jurisdictions, including defining audit scope, reviewing audit workpapers, evaluating control effectiveness, and ensuring timely completion of audit deliverables. Oversee audit assignments covering traditional financial-services activities as well as emerging digital asset- and crypto-related business lines, including governance, outsourcing and broader regulatory risks. Lead discussions with stakeholders and senior management regarding audit observations, management action plans, remediation timelines, and risk mitigation measures. Prepare, review, challenge and finalize audit reports, ensuring that audit findings and recommendations are clear, practical, risk-focused, and aligned with the nature and complexity of the business. Ensure compliance with Internal Audit methodology, professional standards, internal procedures, and regulatory expectations applicable to regulated financial-services entities. Monitor and validate the remediation of audit findings and provide robust assessment of the effectiveness and sustainability of corrective actions implemented by management. Build and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders, second-line functions, senior management, external auditors, and key business contacts across multiple jurisdictions and business lines. Support and coach junior audit team members through ongoing guidance, review of audit work, and knowledge sharing across regulatory and operational topics. Contribute to the continuous enhancement of Internal Audit processes, methodologies, risk assessment approaches, and audit coverage across the EMEA region. This list of responsibilities is not exhaustive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities that management deems necessary. Qualifications Knowledge, Skills and Experience A recognized degree in Accounting / Business / Audit / Finance or related fields. Seven to ten years of relevant working experience in internal audit and / or external audit within a multinational financial services firm, regulated financial institution, fintech, digital-assets environment or a recognized accounting firm. Strong understanding of regulatory requirements applicable to investment firms, payment institutions, and financial-services entities in Europe. Strong knowledge of governance, AML/CTF, compliance, ICARA, outsourcing, SOx and internal control frameworks within regulated financial-services environments. Proven experience in independently leading and managing audit assignments, including audit planning, stakeholder discussions, evaluation of control deficiencies, documentation of findings, audit report drafting, and agreement of management action plans. Experience in communicating audit observations and control weaknesses to senior stakeholders in a clear, professional, and constructive manner, including negotiation of remediation actions and target implementation dates. Experience reviewing audit workpapers and providing guidance, feedback, and support to less experienced audit team members. Experience working in cross-border and multicultural environments with the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders across different jurisdictions and levels of seniority. Strong oral and written communication skills in English are mandatory; French, German or other additional European languages are considered an advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to apply sound professional judgment and identify practical, risk-based solutions. Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and reliably deliver high-quality work within agreed deadlines. High level of integrity, professional skepticism, attention to detail, and commitment to quality. Willingness to continuously learn and develop technical, regulatory, and business knowledge in a rapidly evolving financial-services environment. Solid computer skills; experience with audit-management tools, data analytics, technology-enabled auditing techniques, and the practical use of AI-assisted tools to support audit research, documentation, and analysis is considered an advantage.

jobs.description: Job Description Summary En tant que Chef de projet principal (Lead Project Manager), vous serez responsable de la planification et de l'exécution des contrats, depuis la réunion de transfert jusqu'à la gestion de la Qualité, des Coûts et des Délais (QCD) de l'ensemble du processus d'exécution. Vous devrez garantir une livraison dans les délais conformément aux clauses contractuelles, assurer un haut niveau de satisfaction client, et contrôler ainsi qu'optimiser la marge brute et la trésorerie liées aux contrats. Nous nous engageons à fournir des équipements de sous-station personnalisés de haute qualité à nos clients du secteur des services publics en Amérique du Nord. As a Lead Project Manager, you will be responsible for planning and executing contracts starting from transfer meeting to managing the Quality, Cost, and Delivery of the entire execution process by ensuring on time delivery according to contractual terms, high level of customer satisfaction and controlling and improving the Gross Margin and cash related to contracts. We are committed to delivering high quality customized substation equipment to our Utility Customers in North America. Job Description Responsabilités essentielles : Effectuer : La commande du client et la comparer avec le devis de GE lors du transfert du dossier de projet du groupe commercial à la gestion de projet. La Facturation selon les termes du contrat La clôture administrative du projet. Diriger : Le lancement du projet avec tous les contributeurs internes et attribution des rôles et responsabilités. Le lancement avec le client pour communiquer la nature du travail qui sera effectué et clarifier tout problème dans la commande. Les réunions de suivi du projet (internes et externes). Notamment les réunions de suivi de production. Toutes les activités liées au projet (approvisionnement, logistique, douanes, finances...). Assurer le suivi des dépenses du projet par rapport au budget (coût, matériaux, main d'œuvre) et le département des achats de GE sur les livraisons des fournisseurs. Informer régulièrement le client de l'avancement du projet. Produire le rapport d'analyse post-mortem du projet. Responsable de l'émission des ordres de modification et de l'amélioration des processus de gestion de projet : préparation et suivi de projet, contrats de service, etc. Qualifications requises : Baccalauréat en Gestion de Projets ou en Ingénierie. Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en Gestion de projets. Capacité et volonté de voyager jusqu'à 15% du temps aux USA Parfaitement bilingue (Français/Anglais) oral & écrit. (*) Maitrise suite Microsoft Office Connaissance SAP Expérience du marché de la transmission à haute tension un atout Accepter de passer une vérification pré-emploi, incluant des références et des antécédents. Être éligible à travailler au Canada. (*) La fonction requiert de communiquer avec des collègues, des fournisseurs et des clients à l’international, le bilinguisme français / anglais est obligatoire. Caractéristiques souhaitées : Compétences professionnelles démontrées en matière de relations interpersonnelles - haut niveau de motivation, d'intégrité et de confiance en soi. Capacité à prendre des initiatives, à travailler de manière indépendante, à influencer les autres et à diriger fonctionnellement de petites équipes. Excellentes compétences en matière de gestion de projets et succès avéré dans la réalisation de projets grâce à une planification solide et à une exécution persévérante. Comprendre comment aligner les ressources, solliciter l'avis des principaux acteurs et gérer les autres pour atteindre les résultats souhaités. Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément. Capacité avérée à équilibrer la charge de travail dans des délais courts et des priorités changeantes dans un environnement en constante évolution. Bon esprit d'équipe qui soutient son équipe élargie et s'approprie le travail de l'équipe et en assume la responsabilité. Essential Responsibilities: Perform: Customer order review and compare with the GE quote upon transfer of the project file from the Commercial group to Project management. Invoicing according to the contract terms Administrative closing of the project. Lead: Project kick-off meeting with all internal contributors and assign roles and responsibilities. Customer kick-off meeting to communicate the nature of the work that will be done and clarify any issues in the order. Draft project follow-up meeting summaries (internal and external) Coordinate all activities related to the project (procurement, logistics, customs, finance…) Follow project spend vs budget (cost, materials, labor) & GE procurement department on supplier deliveries Communicate and inform the customer of project progress on a regular basis. Produce the project Post-Mortem analysis report Responsible to issue the variation orders & to improve the project management processes: project preparation, Service contracts, etc. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree in Project Management or Engineering Minimum 5 years of relevant Project Management experience. Ability and willingness to travel up to 15% of the time Perfectly Bilingual (English/French) spoken & written Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. SAP Knowledge Experience in the high voltage transmission market Comply with pre-employment screening, including verification and background check. Eligible to work in Canada Desired Characteristics: Demonstrated professional interpersonal skills – high level of motivation, integrity, self- confidence, Ability to take initiative, to work independently, to influence others and lead small teams Excellent project management skills with proven success to push projects over the finish line with sound planning and persistent execution. Understand how to align resources, seek the input of key constituents, and manage others to achieve desired results. Lead initiatives of moderate scope and impact Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently. Demonstrated ability to balance workload under short deadlines and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment Good team player who supports their extended team and embraces ownership, accountability, and responsibility for the team's work. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs.description: Who We Are As the largest private-sector power producer in the world and the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, Constellation is focused on our purpose: lighting the way to a brilliant tomorrow for all. We have been the leader in clean energy production for more than a decade, and we are cultivating a workplace where our employees can grow, thrive, and contribute. Now integrated with Calpine, our portfolio includes 55 gigawatts of capacity from nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities, with the generating capacity to power the equivalent of 27 million homes. Our culture and employee experience make it clear: We are powered by passion and purpose. Together, we're creating healthier communities and a cleaner planet, and our people are the driving force behind our success. At Constellation, you can build a fulfilling career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact. By doing our best work and meeting new challenges, we can accomplish great things. Join us in meeting the country's energy needs today and tomorrow. Total Rewards Constellation offers an extensive selection of benefits and rewards to help our employees thrive professionally and personally. We provide competitive compensation and a wide-range of benefits that support both employees and their families, helping them prepare for the future. In addition to highly competitive salaries, eligible employees are offered a bonus program, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase program; comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, including robust wellbeing programs; disability and life insurance benefits; paid time off for vacation, holidays, and sick days; and much more. Expected salary range of $192,600 to $214,000, varies based on experience, along with comprehensive benefits package that includes bonus and 401(k). Primary Purpose of Position A senior lawyer who is a highly qualified attorney handling complex legal matters and projects on behalf of the Company. Primary Duties and Accountabilities Serve as principal legal advisor supporting the day-to-day operation of Constellation’s non-nuclear generation assets on the East Coast and Mid-West. Partner directly with operations leadership, commercial teams, engineering, environmental, asset management, and legal subject matter experts to identify legal and commercial risk early and develop creative business-oriented strategies that enable safe and reliable operations of the assets. Broad legal experience preferred, with energy, environmental or asset management experience a plus. Will advise on compliance, environmental, financial, real property, tax, commercial, and corporate issues. Draft, negotiate, and advise on a broad range of complex operational agreements, including co-generation steam and energy supply, fuel supply, O&M, LTSA, procurement, construction and real estate agreements. Provide strategic legal support during planned outages, forced outages, emergency operations events, major equipment failures and restoration activities. Assist in mergers, acquisitions and divestitures, asset integrations, including due diligence, transaction documentation, regulatory approvals. Manage outside counsel to maximize benefits and minimize costs. Required to have or develop familiarity but not primary responsibility for federal and wholesale power market (PJM, ISO-NE, and NYISO) regulatory matters associated with these power plants (and ability to support associated compliance efforts). Ability to collaborate with Constellation legal department subject matter experts, including Operations, Environmental Health & Safety, Construction/Engineering, Government and Regulatory, Trading and Origination, Tax, Accounting and Public Relations/ Corporate Communications to develop practical legal solutions that support fleet optimization, Build trusted relationships across all levels of the organization by translating complex legal issues into clear, actionable business advice Minimum Qualifications 8-years professional experience in a specialized area of law Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly both orally and in writing and to analyze legal materials and data Excellent legal research, analytical abilities, and knowledge of federal and or state law Demonstrated comprehensive knowledge of legal principles, practices, and procedures, with the ability to apply them to complex assignments An LLB or JD from an accredited law school and be licensed to practice law in the relevant jurisdictions Preferred Qualifications 6+years of practicing commercial law in a law firm or corporation, including substantial experience providing commercial legal support to power generation assets or energy infrastructure. Deep understanding of power generation operations in PJM, ISO-NE and NYISO. Experience serving as the primary legal advisor to plant operations, commercial and asset management teams.

jobs.description: ARE YOU A CURRENT US FOODS EMPLOYEE? PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY THROUGH OUR INTERNAL WORKDAY CAREER SITE Join Our Community of Food People! BECOME A US FOODS® Van Driver! Ready to build a career with a company that’s leading the foodservice industry? We help YOU make it! Our Van Drivers make $21.68/hr Schedule: Generally working Tuesday - Saturday typically starting at 8am The Non CDL Driver I is a delivery position responsible for driving a company vehicle limited to a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW) of 14,900. The position will be assigned stops to deliver foodservice products with a high level of service to customers. Commercial or professional driving experience preferred, but not required. Must meet the medical requirements of the Department of Transportation (DOT). All functions must be completed in a safe and timely manner and in accordance with the Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES An individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential duty listed below. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Essential Job Functions: Lift up to 50 lbs. on a frequent basis and up to 100 lbs. on an occasional basis. Load and unload the vehicle for multi-stop deliveries. Transport deliveries by driving assigned vehicles. Use hand truck to move product from the delivery vehicle into the customer location including going up and down stairs with product as necessary. Accurately record delivery information including operating a hand scanner and all company required documentation. Responsible for the proper documentation and disposition for any return product. Communicate delivery-customer issues to proper authority (i.e., Customer Service, Territory Manager, Transportation Supervisor, etc.). Deliver product to each of the designated stops following the stop sequence provided for the day. Unload product safely and stage product in the space(s) designated by customer. Check invoice for complete delivery. Process paperwork and damaged merchandise if any. Collect payments if necessary. Monitor refrigeration system on the delivery vehicle on a consistent basis for safety; follow all safe food handling procedures. Perform pre-trip and post-trip inspections such as monitoring fluid levels, tires, windshield wash and replenishing fuel. Other duties as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS Education/Training: High school diploma or general education degree (GED) preferred Related Experience/Requirements: Must be 21 years of age or older. Valid U.S. driver’s license issued by the state of legal residence with proper endorsements if required. No more than two convictions in the past two-year period for traffic violations, no DUI convictions in the past three years, no driver’s license suspensions in the past three years. Must be able to pass DOT physical. No commercial or professional driving experience required. One year of multi-stop delivery experience is preferred or six months local delivery experience and/or foodservice industry experience. Hand cart delivery experience preferred. Able to read, write and communicate in English as it relates to the job and safety regulations. Must have basic math skills (add, subtract, multiply, divide). Must pass pre-employment testing (including items such a Background Check) Have knowledge of area and/or map reading abilities. Use safe lifting and loading techniques Great interpersonal/customer service skills. Availability to work on weekends, Holidays and overtime in order to service customers Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: To be successful in this position, the individual performing the duties must successfully demonstrate the following competencies: Building Customer Loyalty Managing Work Adaptability Building Trust Follow-up Communication Demonstrate Defensive Driving techniques No more than two convictions in the past two year period for traffic violations. No more than one of these may be a serious as defined by DOT (e.g., leaving scene of an accident, reckless driving, homicide/assault, eluding police, at fault offense, refusing a breathalyzer test, committing a felony with a vehicle) violation or result of an accident - company or private vehicle; No DUI convictions within past three years, regardless of type of vehicle operated; no driver's license suspension within past three years (insurance and overweight tickets are excluded); and no termination by previous employer for failure to comply with safety regulations or for accident involvement. Physical Requirements: This work requires the following physical activities: climbing, bending, stooping, kneeling, twisting, reaching, sitting, standing, walking, and lifting up to 50 lbs. of material on a consistent basis, 100 lbs. on an occasional basis and repetitive motions. The work is performed primarily outdoors. Must be able to pass DOT physical. Must be able to work in extreme weather conditions. Must be able to perform the following physical activities for described length of time: Compensation depends on relevant experience and/or education, specific skills, function, geographic location, and other factors as applicable by law. The expected base rate for this role is between $ 19.00 and $25.00 Benefits for this role may include health insurance, pre-tax spending accounts, retirement benefits, paid time off, short-term and long-term disability, employee stock purchase plan, and life insurance. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

본 포지션은 쿠팡의 핵심 비즈니스를 지원하는 IT 인프라 분야의 전략적 소싱을 담당하며, 전사 차원의 조달 혁신을 주도하는 핵심 역할입니다. 주요 이해관계자와 긴밀히 협업하여 비즈니스 과제를 해결하고, 카테고리 관리, 전략적·운영적 소싱, 공급업체 관리 체계를 고도화함으로써 비용 효율성, 공급 안정성 및 비즈니스 성과 향상에 기여합니다.

jobs.description: Job Classification: Investment Management - Investments PGIM: 2027 Real Estate, Sophomore Externship Program Location: Newark, NJ Your Opportunity: Are you a sophomore interested in learning about careers in commercial real estate? Would you like to get a jump start on 2028 summer internship recruiting while networking with leaders at a Fortune 100 company? PGIM will host a 3-day sophomore externship in January 2027 to educate students on its asset management business and opportunities for internships and careers with the firm. PGIM Real Estate Overview: PGIM is the diversified asset management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. With $1.4 trillion in assets under management and 41 offices spanning 20 countries, PGIM is among the world’s leading asset managers. With $218 billion in gross assets under management and administration ($139 billion net), PGIM Real Estate provides investors and borrowers access to real estate equity, real estate debt, agriculture, and impact solutions across the risk-return spectrum. Our execution capabilities and industry insights are backed by a 50-year legacy of investing in commercial real estate, a 140-year history of real estate financing, and the local experience of professionals in 35 cities globally. Program Overview: PGIM will host a 3-day externship on January 5th through 7th, 2027 at Prudential’s Newark, NJ headquarters. This program is intended for students graduating between December 2028-May 2029. Transportation and lodging will be provided to those selected to participate in our program. Externs will engage in training, case studies, job shadowing, and networking during our program. For those selected to participate in the externship, there will also be opportunities to interview for a summer 2028 10-week paid summer internship upon conclusion of the program! During the sophomore externship we’ll be showcasing 3 different areas across our real estate platform. These businesses use their internship program as the main feeder into their full-time Analyst programs: Equity: Asset Management & Transactions Our Equity business invests in and manages commercial real estate across a range of property types and risk profiles. Participants will learn how our teams evaluate new opportunities and manage assets throughout the investment lifecycle. Acquisitions (Transactions): Support the sourcing, underwriting, financial modeling, and due diligence of new acquisitions and developments. Work may include cash flow and waterfall models, sensitivity analyses, rent roll reviews, comparable property analysis, and materials used to evaluate investment opportunities. Asset Management: Collaborate with partners, consultants, property managers, and leasing brokers to oversee operating assets, development projects, and repositioning strategies. Teams monitor property performance and help execute leasing, operational, financing, and disposition strategies. Debt – Originations Our Originations business evaluates and secures commercial real estate loans across property types, structures, and geographies. Participants will learn how teams assess new debt investment opportunities and move transactions through due diligence and closing. Support market research, credit analysis, property valuation, cash flow modeling, Argus modeling, and sensitivity analysis. Assist with due diligence and closing materials while coordinating with internal teams and external partners. Debt – Agency Our Agency Lending business supports multifamily real estate financing through capital sources including Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and FHA. Participants will learn about opportunities within Underwriting and Portfolio or Deal Management. Support market research, credit analysis, property valuation, cash flow modeling, Argus modeling, and sensitivity analysis. Underwriting: Analyze potential loans, coordinate due diligence, assess cash flow assumptions and market data, and help prepare investment packages for credit approval. Portfolio or Deal Management: Support credit officers and origination teams throughout the life cycle of a deal, including policies, procedures, production goals, and loan submission materials. Analytical work may include market research, due diligence tracking, financial modeling, property valuation, and borrower credit assessment. What you’ll need: Candidates must be enrolled in an accredited bachelor’s degree program graduating between December 2028 and May 2029 All majors welcome! Candidates should have an interest in exploring careers across commercial real estate Minimum GPA of 3.0 required Prudential does not provide visa sponsorship for this program. Successful candidates must possess the requisite US employment authorization to be eligible for consideration Here’s what to expect when you apply: Submit your application . Apply to up to three roles that best match your interests and skills. Complete a first round video interview . If selected, you’ll be invited to record responses to a few interview questions. This helps our teams get to know you better and allows you to share your story on your own time. Join us for final round interviews . If you advance, you’ll be invited to meet with our team—either virtually or in person—to learn more about our business, culture, and role. ​ Prudential Financial, Inc. of the United States is not affiliated with Prudential plc. which is headquartered in the United Kingdom. Prudential is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetics, disability, marital status, age, veteran status, domestic partner status, medical condition or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please email accommodations.hw@prudential.com .
